name: qp-author
description: Author and validate QPortfolio portfolio, scenario and model Portable-JSON files from plain-language descriptions, and work with a live Q Portfolio installation — load files in, run optimizations, read results. Grounded in the QP domain vault.

qp_url.title: Q Portfolio MCP address
qp_url.description: The MCP address your administrator gave you, e.g. https://portfolio-mcp.example.com, with no slash at the end (not the Portfolio web page you log in to). It also serves the Portfolio knowledge base. Leave empty to only build files offline.

qp_api_key.title: Q Portfolio API key
qp_api_key.description: In Portfolio, open Account Settings and create an MCP API key (starts with qpk_). Stored in your system's secure credential store.
